usage: 炒豬肉 (stir-fried pork) is used as a noun to refer to a specific dish.
You can talk about liking 炒豬肉 or ordering 炒豬肉 in a restaurant.
炒豬肉 can be part of a phrase describing a meal, like 'a dish of 炒豬肉'.
When describing the dish, you can add adjectives before 炒豬肉, such as 'delicious 炒豬肉'.
炒豬肉 typically appears in menus or food conversations as the name of the dish.
